The handrail is dark polished wood, supported by numerous slender, turned wooden balusters. Strong artificial lighting creates high-contrast reflections on the glossy surfaces. The background shows a hallway with recessed ceiling lights and a glimpse of another room.

The connection points where the balusters meet the bottom rail/stringer are indistinct and muddy. Several balusters seem to merge into the background or the floor without a clear mechanical joint or base plate, typical of AI structural ambiguity.

The perspective lines of the ceiling lights and the far wall do not align perfectly with the camera angle established by the railing. The background elements feel slightly warped or 'painted on' rather than existing in a coherent 3D space.
